info.title: Event Schedule API
info.description: API for managing events, schedules, and tickets on Event Schedule. To get started, register an account, then create a schedule before adding events. Write operations require a Pro plan. New accounts get a trial period.

post.description: Sends a 6-digit verification code to the provided email address. This is only required in hosted mode (eventschedule.com). Selfhosted instances do not require email verification. Rate limited to 5 codes per email per hour.

email.description: Email address to send the verification code to

422.description: Validation error or email already registered

post.description: Creates a new user account and returns an API key. In hosted mode, a verification code (from /register/send-code) is required. In selfhosted mode, registration is only allowed if no users exist yet. Rate limited to 3 registrations per IP per hour.

verification_code.description: 6-digit verification code from /register/send-code (required in hosted mode only)

api_key.description: API key for authenticating future requests. Store this securely.

api_key_expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the API key expires

403.description: Registration is closed (selfhosted mode with existing users)

post.description: Authenticates with email and password, returning a new API key. If an active API key already exists, returns a 409 error - disable and re-enable API access in account settings to generate a new key. Store the key securely. Accounts with two-factor authentication enabled must generate an API key from the web UI instead. Rate limited to 5 attempts per IP per 15 minutes.

api_key.description: New API key for authenticating future requests. Store this securely.

api_key_expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the API key expires

409.description: An active API key already exists

403.description: Account has two-factor authentication enabled

post.description: Calls an event off without deleting it. The event keeps its page and every sale, leaves the public calendar and any connected calendar, and stops selling. Running boost campaigns and installment plans are stopped. Sales are not refunded. An event that is already cancelled is left as it is. An appointment booking is cancelled through its sale.

post.description: Undoes a cancellation. The event returns to the public calendar and to connected calendars. Nobody is emailed, and a boost campaign or installment plan that the cancellation stopped stays stopped. An event that is not cancelled is left as it is.

parameters.name: id

get.description: The appointment types a guest can book on this schedule right now, the list its /book page shows. On the hosted service, types with a price or an approval step are left out until the schedule has its own email settings, because a guest booked through the API is sent a way to pay, or told the schedule's answer, only by email. The key's account must be an owner or admin of the schedule, and the schedule must be on a Pro plan.

parameters.name: subdomain
parameters.description: The schedule's subdomain

403.description: Not an owner or admin of the schedule, or not a Pro account

get.description: The times still open for an appointment type. Each slot carries its start as a UTC instant, to send back when booking, and a label in the schedule's timezone and language, such as "Tuesday, October 20 at 2:30 PM EDT". When the range has nothing open, meta.next_available is the first open time after it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The encoded ID of the appointment type

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day to look at (Y-m-d, in the schedule's timezone). Defaults to today.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: How many days to cover. Defaults to 7.

next_available.description: Set only when this range has nothing open

403.description: Not an owner or admin of the schedule, or not a Pro account

422.description: Validation error, or the type is not taking bookings

post.description: Book a time for a guest. The booking is the guest's: the caller does not become its buyer, and the owner's Bookings list and booking email say it was booked through the API. A booking paid online is held until pay_by, and the guest is emailed a link to pay at once. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make a retry safe: a repeat of the same request with the same key in the next 24 hours answers with the booking the first one made.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The encoded ID of the appointment type

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 64 letters, digits, dots, colons, dashes or underscores

slot.description: A slot's starts_at, exactly as the slots endpoint gave it (UTC, e.g. 2026-10-20T18:30:00Z)

email.description: The guest's email, where the confirmation or the payment link goes

phone.description: Required when the type's requires_phone is true; ignored when it does not ask

guest_timezone.description: The guest's IANA timezone, for their emails

answers.description: Answers to the type's questions, keyed by question key. Each is text or a number, or a list of them, each up to 1000 characters.

403.description: Not an owner or admin of the schedule, or not a Pro account

409.description: The time was just taken (error slot_taken, with the three nearest open times in alternatives), the same guest already holds it (already_booked, with that booking), or a request with the same Idempotency-Key is still being handled

422.description: Validation error per field, the type is not taking bookings, the daily cap on new bookings, or an Idempotency-Key reused for a different request

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key obtained from /login or /register. Keys expire after one year.

subdomain.description: Unique subdomain identifier for the schedule

short_description.description: Short description of the schedule (plain text, max 200 characters)

profile_image_url.description: URL of the schedule's profile image

starts_at.description: Event start date and time in UTC (Y-m-d H:i:s)

ends_at.description: End date and time in UTC (Y-m-d H:i:s): the start plus the duration, to the minute. Null when the event has no length. For a recurring event, the end of the first date

venue_id.description: Encoded ID of the associated venue schedule

venue_address1.description: Street address of the associated venue

venue_subdomain.description: Subdomain of the associated venue schedule

is_private.description: Whether the event is private (hidden from calendar, only accessible via direct link)

external_id.description: The id your own system gave the event. Unique for the schedule that owns the event, compared exactly

is_cancelled.description: Whether the event is cancelled. Changed only through POST /events/{id}/cancel and /restore

is_password_protected.description: Whether the event page is protected by a password

schedule_type.description: Whether this is a single or recurring event

recurring_frequency.description: Recurrence frequency (only present for recurring events)

recurring_interval.description: Interval for every_n_weeks frequency (only present for recurring events)

days_of_week.description: 7-character string where each position represents a day (Sunday to Saturday), '1' means active (only present for recurring events)

recurring_end_type.description: How the recurrence ends (only present for recurring events)

recurring_end_value.description: End date (Y-m-d) or number of occurrences, depending on recurring_end_type

tickets_enabled.description: Whether ticket sales are enabled for this event

terms_url.description: URL to terms and conditions for ticket sales

tickets.description: Ticket types for this event (only present when tickets are enabled)

members.description: Map of encoded member schedule IDs to member details

event_parts.description: Sub-sections or segments of the event

group.description: Sub-schedule assignment for this event on this schedule

starts_at.description: Start date and time in UTC (Y-m-d H:i:s format, required for create)

ends_at.description: End date and time in UTC (Y-m-d H:i:s). Another way to give the length: send it instead of duration. Must be after the start and at most 8760 hours after it. Sent together with a duration that disagrees, the one that differs from the stored value wins on an update; a 422 when both were changed or the event is new. Null changes nothing

event_password.description: Password to protect the event page

is_private.description: Make event private (hidden from calendar, only accessible via direct link)

schedule_type.description: Whether this is a single or recurring event

recurring_frequency.description: Recurrence frequency (required when schedule_type is recurring)

recurring_end_value.description: End date (Y-m-d) for on_date, or number of occurrences for after_events

days_of_week.description: 7-character string where each position represents a day (Sunday to Saturday), '1' means the event recurs on that day. Only used with weekly or every_n_weeks frequency.

venue_id.description: Encoded ID of a venue schedule to associate with the event

venue_name.description: Venue name (used to look up an existing venue schedule)

venue_address1.description: Venue address (used together with venue_name to look up an existing venue schedule)

members.description: Array of member objects with name and/or email to associate talent schedules with the event

name.description: Member name (used to look up an existing talent schedule)

email.description: Member email (used to look up an existing talent schedule)

flyer_image_url.description: The address of a picture to use as the flyer. It is fetched once, before anything is saved, and stored as our own file: a public http or https address that answers within 10 seconds with a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP of at most 8 MB, else a 422. On update a new address replaces the flyer, null removes it, and the address the event already reports is no change

external_id.description: The id your own system knows this event by. Unique for the schedule that owns the event and compared exactly. On create, an id the schedule already has an event for is a 409. On update, a value sets or changes it and null clears it

upsert.description: POST only, with external_id: true updates the event that already has the id instead of answering 409. The update follows the rules of PUT /events/{id} and is not counted against the daily cap

schedule.description: Sub-schedule slug to assign this event to

type.description: Ticket type name (e.g. General Admission, VIP)

quantity.description: Number of tickets available (0 or omit for unlimited)

event_parts.description: Sub-sections or segments of the event

quantity.description: Number of tickets available (null for unlimited)

subdomain.description: Subdomain of the schedule where the sale was made

secret.description: Secret key for accessing the ticket (only visible to event owner)

total_quantity.description: Total number of tickets in this sale

from.description: First item number on this page

to.description: Last item number on this page

id.description: Encoded submission ID, unique only within a given type

event_part_id.description: Encoded agenda part ID, when the submission targets one

is_guest_submission.description: True when submitted without an account

errors.description: Field-level validation errors (keyed by field name, values are arrays of error messages)

date.description: The day, in the schedule's timezone

label.description: A sentence to read to the guest, in the schedule's timezone and language

payment.description: cash is paid at the appointment; online is paid from a link the guest is emailed

location.description: The address or phone number. A meeting link is sent with the confirmation.

host_name.description: The team member the appointment is with

pay_by.description: When an unpaid hold is released (awaiting_payment only)

manage_url.description: The guest's page for the booking, where they pay, change the time or cancel

summary.description: A sentence for an agent to read back to the guest

Boost.description: A boost request on one of a boost partner's schedules. It launches under the partner's own Facebook Page and ad account only when the current version is approved AND the current budget is paid.

status.description: ready: approved and paid, waiting only for the partner's account to be confirmed

version.description: Raised by every change to what the ad says or shows

confirmed.description: True only when the confirmed payment is for the current budget

final.description: True once Meta's figures for an ended boost have stopped moving

meta_review.description: Meta's reason, when it refused the ad

stop_reason.description: The note given, or a code: partner, business, withdrawn, access_withdrawn, event_removed

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Register, login, and manage API keys. Authentication endpoints have their own rate limits: registration is limited to 3 per IP per hour, login to 5 per IP per 15 minutes, and verification codes to 5 per email per hour.

tags.name: Schedules
tags.description: Manage schedules. A schedule represents a venue, talent, or curator that hosts events. Create a schedule before adding events.

tags.name: Sub-schedules
tags.description: Manage sub-schedules within a schedule. Sub-schedules allow you to organize events into categories within a schedule. Requires a Pro plan for write operations.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Manage events. Events belong to schedules and can have tickets, recurring configurations, and associated members. Write operations require a Pro plan. Rate limits: GET requests are limited to 300 per minute, POST/PUT/DELETE requests are limited to 30 per minute.

tags.name: Sales
tags.description: Manage ticket sales for events. Supports creating, listing, viewing, updating status (mark as paid, refund, cancel), and deleting sales. Events must have tickets enabled and belong to a Pro schedule.

tags.name: Feedback
tags.description: Read post-event ratings and fan submissions (comments, photos, videos) for your own schedules. Feedback requires a Pro plan; fan content is available on all plans.

tags.name: Appointments
tags.description: List an appointment type's open times and book them, for an agent that talks to the guest (a voice agent on a phone line, for example). Requires a Pro plan.

tags.name: Boosts
tags.description: For a boost partner: a network whose schedules boost under its own Facebook Page and Meta ad account. Approve or decline each version, record payment, stop campaigns, and read the monthly statements. Only the partner account's own key can use these.
